decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 10th June 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The existing out building, being 5.6m deep and 7.22m wide, with a ridged roof height of 3.8m, that takes the total area of outbuilding coverage to approximately 15% of the dwellings curtilage, as shown on the plans received on the 16th April 2004 constitutes permitted development as defined by Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended) and therefore does not require planning permission.

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE 

The detached out building hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse at 26 The Drive and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office development).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of existing detached building in rear end of garden to dwellinghouse.
